discovery.rationale: Objective, local-only classification, authority boundary, risk, and acceptance criteria are tracked.

architecture.rationale: Local research and runtime state are separated from Yahoo, ESPN, and Sleeper authority through explicit read, recommend, approve, execute, and verify contracts.

development.rationale: The tool is typed, offline, dependency-light, explicit about bootstrap, and covered by deterministic tests.

data_ai.rationale: Only supported public artifacts or sanitized snapshots are accepted; provenance, upstream-family deduplication, freshness, omissions, conflicts, and board revisions are explicit; no model asset or online learning exists.

build_supply_chain.rationale: Runtime uses the Python standard library; pytest is the only development dependency.

verification.rationale: Offline tests cover deterministic behavior and sanitized platform fixtures; a witnessed timed browser mock remains independently required before writes on each platform.

provisioning.rationale: Only the explicit init command can create the local SQLite schema; runtime commands validate and fail when it is absent.

release_deployment.rationale: This release is a local CLI with no deployed service or production environment.
release_deployment.applicability_rationale: There is no cloud artifact, deployment target, release identity, or production approval gate.

operations.rationale: Doctor, status, replay, cancellation, disarm, pure recommendation, and fail-closed intent decisions expose local operating state.

incident_recovery.rationale: Hash-chain replay, atomic validation, reconciliation, issued-intent cancellation, strict no-retry verification, disarm, and takeover are tested offline; live browser recovery must be witnessed per platform.

retirement.rationale: The run is retired by disarming, retaining only sanitized evidence, and deleting the private local directory.
